info.title: Bazaar internal Alpha API
info.description: Implemented Alpha contract. Provisioned password accounts and optional Google Gmail registration; email-code APIs are unavailable until a sender is installed. Simulated settlement and seller image uploads; no wallet or real payments. Every response returns X-Request-Id; errors contain code, retryable and the same requestId. Private/auth responses no-store. Admission saturation returns 503 OVERLOADED with retryable=true and Cache-Control: no-store before authentication/database work; POST /health/live is exempt. Write retries must preserve the original payload and idempotency key.

parameters.description: Must exactly match configured APP_ORIGIN. Missing/null origin rejected.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional diagnostic ID. Invalid values are replaced; the effective ID is returned in the response header and error body.

session.name: bazaar_session
session.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/; Secure outside loopback HTTP; fixed 12h.

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: Obtained from login/session; required for authenticated writes in addition to exact Origin.

Error.description: Database connectivity or pool availability failures return HTTP 503 with code DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE and retryable=true. Retry writes with the original body and idempotency key; a failed response does not prove the transaction was rolled back. Driver messages and connection details are never returned.

amount.description: Positive decimal string, at most 20 integer digits. Currency scales from POST /currencies; reject excess scale, never round.

url.description: Stable application GET path; order URLs require participant authorization.

canEdit.description: Whether content edits are currently permitted; one-off listings lock after the first order.

priceUsd.description: Unrounded USD reference decimal string; null without a quote. Does not change original price.

supplyMode.description: Single reserves one digital entitlement at order creation; cancellation releases it, completion consumes it, and a refund keeps it unavailable. Delivery reference and access code remain private order data.

priceAmount.description: Positive only. Currency scale: CNY 2, USDT 6, ETH 18, SOL 9; reject excess scale, never round.

sourceAsOf.description: null: upstream does not disclose price timestamp

quoteId.description: Required for later price-sorted pages; valid until the snapshot expiresAt (one-hour cache lifetime)

RequestId.description: Effective request correlation ID generated or accepted by the server.
